subtopics.title: Word jobs
subtopics.zero: Identify what job the word performs in the sentence: naming, replacing, acting, describing, modifying or connecting.
subtopics.visual: Noun=name; Pronoun=replaces; Verb=action/state; Adjective=describes noun; Adverb=modifies
subtopics.rule: Ask: what is this word doing here?

examples.question: She quickly completed the difficult task

subtopics.traps: The same word may perform different jobs in different sentences.
